methodology.per_fold_protocol: train locations fit the probe; validation location selects fusion parameters; held-out test location is evaluated once

interpretation_limits: The 64-feature classifier is an experimental linear probe, not a frozen production branch.
Adjacent regions from one recording are correlated; publication intervals must cluster by sample_source_id.
The four locations are development cross-validation; UZ/iGent remain necessary for final external validation.
No LLM decision is evaluated in this stage.
